Name: Appliable Mayonnaise
Author: AbrahMods
Description:
[center][u][b][size=6]APPLIABLE MAYONNAISE MOD[/size][/b][/u][/center]
[left]
[/left]
You can apply any mayo you want on any food you like! It will change the name, visual and price of your food. Hıgher quality mayo will add higher price, health and energy to your food. 

Normal mayo - gives the food a white tinted mayo topping
Void mayo - gives the food a black tinted mayo topping.
Duck mayo - gives the food  a more yellowish mayo topping.
Dino mayo - gives the food a more greenish mayo topping.

How to apply mayo on your food?

1. Press "esc" to open your inventory menu and pick up your mayo of choice.
[img width=518,height=475]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1334937035856810025/1503359367410487336/2026-05-11_3.png?ex=6a031004&is=6a01be84&hm=5a3e1280996aad9400839af0f38f0f20f6646b841dc6151cafa8e13068f225c1&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=648&height=594[/img]

2. Click it on your food and done. Enjoy!
[img width=498,height=407]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1334937035856810025/1503364161336381490/2026-05-11_9.png?ex=6a03147b&is=6a01c2fb&hm=0f3b8a0efc860280e7d19bc65cb4aaa720698f3cccc4c06fa2abfb86855c5a2d&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=623&height=509[/img]


[b][i][size=5]How much does the price, energy and health of the food increase?[/size][/i][/b]

Depends on the quality and tyoe  of mayo.

quality levels: regular- silver- gold- iridium

Normal mayo:    1.25x / 1.40x / 1.60x / 1.90x
Duck mayo:      1.35x / 1.50x / 1.70x / 2.00x
Void mayo:      1.45x / 1.60x / 1.80x / 2.10x
Dinosaur mayo:  1.75x / 1.90x / 2.10x / 2.40x
[size=5]
REQUIREMENTS:[/size]
SMAPI
CONTENT PATCHER
